<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos():
    out = {}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y') and n['pixels'] > 30:
            b = n['boundary']
            out[n['color']+str(n['id'])] = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b))
    return out
for d in ['UP','DOWN','RIGHT']:
    before = pos()
    r = action([d])
    res = {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')}
    after = pos()
    moved = {k:(before.get(k),v) for k,v in after.items() if before.get(k)!=v}
    print(d, res, 'moved:', moved)
    if res['level_completed'] or res['done']: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
